name: Harpy Raiders
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
narrative.objectives:
Collect 8 Witchwing talons.

Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, adventurer. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
narrative.requestItemsText: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 15 to 20, 5,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Harpy Raiders
quests.objectiveText: Collect 8 Witchwing talons. Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Harpy Lieutenants
quests.objectiveText: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Serena Bloodfeather
quests.objectiveText: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
